#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `price` | `string` | **yes** | The price's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro-monthly-usd`). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grants_credit` | `object` | no | Credit this price grants. `{"kind":"pack", …}` on a one-time price: each paid invoice line grants `amount` × quantity (paid credit, active once the invoice is paid). `{"kind":"per_cycle", …}` on a recurring price: `amount` × item quantity of promotional credit each period, with optional rollover. Null grants nothing. |
| `grants_credit.kind` | `string` | **yes** | The grants credit's kind. One of `pack`, `per_cycle`. |
| `grants_credit.unit` | `string` | **yes** | A credit unit id. Null = money. |
| `grants_credit.amount` | `integer` | **yes** | In the unit's smallest step (money: minor units). |
| `grants_credit.priority` | `integer` | no | The grants credit's priority. |
| `grants_credit.expires_after` | `object` | no | Packs: the credit expires this many days after the invoice is paid. |
| `grants_credit.applicability` | `object` | no | Which invoice lines the grant may pay: `{"kind":"metered"}` (every usage line, the default), `{"kind":"prices","prices":["…"]}`, or `{"kind":"meters","meters":["…"]}` (meter keys: the usage lines of every price that bills the meter when the grant draws). A `metered` grant takes the business's `credit_config.credit_scope` when one is set. |
| `grants_credit.tax_treatment` | `string` | no | Packs: required, or the business default. `taxed_at_use` is money only. One of `taxed_at_purchase`, `taxed_at_use`. |
| `grants_credit.on_exhausted` | `string` | no | What happens when the credit is used up, for a business with blocking on. Null = not set here. One of `block`, `bill`. |
| `grants_credit.rollover` | `object` | no | Per cycle: `none`, or `carry` floor(remaining × percent ÷ 100) units (optionally capped) into a grant that expires `expire_after_cycles` periods later (null = never). |
| `grants_credit.reset` | `object` | no | Per cycle: when the credits renew (absent = each term). Each window gets its own grant, which pays only the usage inside that window. Credits do not renew by the hour. |
| `grants_credit.first_window` | `string` | no | Per cycle, a calendar window that starts before the subscription: grant it in full, prorated, or wait for the first full window. Null = the business setting. One of `full`, `prorated`, `next_full_window`. |
| `meter` | `string` | no | Bill from this meter's events. Models usage, tiered, volume or package. The usage aggregation is copied from the meter. Fixed after create. |
| `unit_amount_decimal` | `string` | no | The default rate: minor units per `quantity_divisor` units. A decimal string with at most 12 decimal places and no exponent, for example `"0.000125"`. "$3 per 1M tokens" is `"300"` with divisor 1000000. |
| `quantity_divisor` | `integer` | no | The rate is per this many units. Default 1. |
| `amount_source` | `string` | no | `rate` (default): quantity × rate. `event_amount`: the sum of the events' `amount`. `event_cost`: the sum of `cost` × (1 + `markup_percent` ÷ 100). `model_price_list`: each combination at the selling rate: a fixed rate in `rates`, else its markup base × (1 + markup ÷ 100); a combination with no base bills `unit_amount_decimal`. `event_cost_or_list`: the events that carry a `cost` bill that cost × (1 + markup ÷ 100), on their own line; the events without one (or with a cost in another currency) bill as `model_price_list`; a fixed rate for a combination wins over both. The last two: the usage model only, on a sum or count meter with a `price_list` mapping. One of `rate`, `event_amount`, `event_cost`, `model_price_list`, `event_cost_or_list`. |
| `markup_percent` | `string` | no | `event_cost`, `model_price_list` and `event_cost_or_list` only: a decimal percent, 0 or more, up to 6 decimal places. |
| `markup_base` | `string` | no | `model_price_list` and `event_cost_or_list` only. `list` (default): the model price list, else your cost. `cost`: your cost, else the list. One of `list`, `cost`, `null`. |
| `rates` | `array of object` | no | The rate card. A combination that no row names bills at the price's own rate. |
| `rates.match` | `object` | **yes** | Group values over some of the meter's `group_by`. The row naming the most values wins, then the oldest. |
| `rates.unit_amount_decimal` | `string` | no | Minor units per `quantity_divisor` units. A decimal string with at most 12 decimal places and no exponent, for example `"0.000125"`. |
| `rates.markup_percent` | `string` | no | `model_price_list` and `event_cost_or_list` only: percent over the price's markup base (and, for `event_cost_or_list`, over the events' own cost), in place of a fixed rate. |
| `rates.tiers` | `array of object` | no | Tiers in the price's model: `up_to`, `unit_amount_decimal`, `flat_amount_minor`. |
| `name` | `string` | no | The price's name. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | no | The price in minor units, e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `tiers` | `array of object` | no | The price tiers, for a tiered, volume or stairstep price. |
| `package_size` | `integer` | no | Units per package, for a package price. |
| `free_units` | `integer` | no | Units included free before charging starts. |
| `percentage_bps` | `integer` | no | The percentage in basis points (100 = 1%), for a percentage price. |
| `minimum_amount_minor` | `integer` | no | Minimum spend for one billing period; null removes it. Recurring prices only. |
| `bill_usage_monthly` | `boolean` | no | Recurring plan prices with a billing period of 2 months or more only. Applies to new subscriptions. |
| `commitment_amount_minor` | `integer` | no | Minimum commitment for one full billing period; null removes it. Recurring plan prices only. Applies to new subscriptions. |
| `show_description_in_invoices` | `boolean` | no | Whether the price's description is printed on invoices. |
| `show_description_in_quotes` | `boolean` | no | Whether the price's description is printed on quotes. |
| `tax_code` | `string` | no | HSN/SAC for this price. Null falls through to the product’s, then the business default. |
| `sku` | `string` | no | The price's SKU. |
| `accounting_code` | `string` | no | Descriptive metadata — NOT a ledger account reference. |
| `accounting_category_code` | `string` | no | The accounting category code for this price. |
| `is_taxable` | `boolean` | no | Whether tax applies to this price. |
| `tax_behavior` | `string` | no | Whether the price includes tax or tax is added on top. One of `inclusive`, `exclusive`. |
| `active` | `boolean` | no | false to archive, true to restore |

| `quantity_divisor` | `integer` | The rate is per this many units. Default 1. |

The last two: the usage model only, on a sum or count meter with a `price_list` mapping. One of `rate`, `event_amount`, `event_cost`, `model_price_list`, `event_cost_or_list`. |
| `markup_percent` | `string` | `event_cost`, `model_price_list` and `event_cost_or_list` only: a decimal percent, 0 or more, up to 6 decimal places. |
| `markup_base` | `string` | `model_price_list` and `event_cost_or_list` only. `list` (default): the model price list, else your cost. `cost`: your cost, else the list. One of `list`, `cost`, `null`. |
| `rates` | `array of object` | The rate card. A combination that no row names bills at the price's own rate. |
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The price's id (`pro-monthly-usd`). |

| `name` | `string` | The price's name. |
| `model` | `string` | The pricing model. |
| `type` | `string` | Whether the price recurs or is charged once. |
| `currency` | `string` | The price's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | The amount in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |

| `is_taxable` | `boolean` | Whether tax applies to this price. |

| `sku` | `string` | SKU. Descriptive metadata — the engine reads it nowhere. |
| `accounting_code` | `string` | Accounting code (“Account Name”). Descriptive metadata — NOT a ledger account reference. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such price |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X PATCH "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/prices/pro-monthly-usd" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Pro monthly",
    "amount_minor": 2900
  }'
```
